WITH stage_0 AS (
  SELECT class_uid, message, "metadata.log_source", "metadata.uid", time FROM __nano_lake_source__
  WHERE time >= '2026-09-24 07:00:00.000000' AND time < '2026-09-25 07:01:00.000000'
  AND (((class_uid = 4001) AND lower("metadata.log_source") != 'audit'))
),
stage_1 AS (
  SELECT toStartOfMinute(time) AS time_bucket, count() AS count
  FROM stage_0
  GROUP BY time_bucket
  ORDER BY time_bucket
)
SELECT * FROM stage_1 LIMIT 501 SETTINGS max_threads=16, max_execution_time=300, optimize_read_in_order=0, optimize_aggregation_in_order=1
